Step:  
06-16-1507 minus 178 days.  
1507 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
Days in months before June 16:  
May: 31, April: 30, March: 31, February: 28, January: 31.  

From June 16 back:  
June: 15 days back → June 1 (15 days subtracted, 178-15=163 left).  
May (31 days) → 163-31=132 left, date at May 1.  
April (30) → 132-30=102 left, date at April 1.  
March (31) → 102-31=71 left, date at March 1.  
February (28) → 71-28=43 left, date at February 1.  
January (31) → 43-31=12 left, date at January 1.  

Remaining 12 days before Jan 1, 1507 → go into December 1506.  
December 1506 has 31 days: Dec 31 minus 12 days = Dec 20, 1506.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1506-12-20
